findings.title: Content-Security-Policy is not set
findings.description: http://127.0.0.1:8765 Without a policy the browser executes any script the page references, so an injected script runs with the page's full authority.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not set to nosniff
findings.description: http://127.0.0.1:8765 Without nosniff a browser may re-interpret a response as a type the server never intended, which turns an upload into a script.

findings.title: X-Frame-Options is not set
findings.description: http://127.0.0.1:8765 Without it, or a CSP frame-ancestors directive, the page can be framed by another origin and clicks on it redressed.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy is not set
findings.description: http://127.0.0.1:8765 Without it the full URL, including anything sensitive in the path or query, is sent to third-party origins the page links to.
